title: Precomposition on coefficient sheaves under sheaf preservation
statement: Let $\mathcal C,\mathcal D$ be categories with Grothendieck topologies $J,K$, and let $\mathcal A$ be a coefficient category. Write $\operatorname{Sh}(J,\mathcal A)$ for the full subcategory of $\mathcal A$-valued presheaves satisfying the sheaf condition [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology]. Given $P:\mathcal C\to\mathcal D$ and a proof that $H\circ P^{\mathrm{op}}$ is a $J$-sheaf for every $K$-sheaf $H$, define $P_*:\operatorname{Sh}(K,\mathcal A)\to\operatorname{Sh}(J,\mathcal A)$ by $(P_*H)(V)=H(P(V))$, with restrictions $H(P(a))$ and with $(P_*\alpha)_V=\alpha_{P(V)}$ on sheaf morphisms. Only the given preservation of coefficient sheaves is assumed; continuity for sheaves of sets, monoidal structures and sheafification are not required.
